title: VTuber debut background artist and animator wanted

Illustration: Day + Night background. Animation: Looping / subtle animation. Style: Ethereal, dreamy, cozy & celestial. more info i will send via dm. Commercial use required. If you’re interested, please reply below or quote retweet with your portfolio, rates, and commission info! Please no AI-generated work. #VTuber #VTuberArtist #VGen #Commission #ArtistSearch #BackgroundArtist #Live2D. Contact: reply or quote retweet.
